en: If that is too little, let me shed
All my blood as well.
Let me open my treasury's mouth,
Let me scatter my wealth.
Such is the command God has sent;
Let me accept it as it is.
To all four corners of the world,
Let me send precise word.
The Muslims throughout the earth—
Let me gather them all.
The suffering people have spoken of this;
Let me agree to their words.
For those who have heard his fame,
Let me hold magnanimous Manas's memorial feast.
For the foolish and feeble-minded,
Let me hold a celebration for my son.
The eight khans upon the earth—
Let me gather them all.
Let me send word to my people.
Gathering the peoples of eight khans,
Holding horse races and a feast,
Devising a thoughtful plan,
Let me send firm word to my people.
Let me gather the peoples of eight khans,
And not stand idly by.
Placing my golden crown upon him,
Seating him on a golden throne,
Let me give my people a spectacle.
This dear lad, gained after such hardship—
Let me raise him as khan over my people.
